name: 多益
source: TOEIC Service List 1.2 & Business Service List 1.20 by Browne, C. & Culligan, B. (CC BY-SA 4.0); 中文釋義由本站整理，同樣以 CC BY-SA 4.0 授權

ex: Please tell {Mister} Lee that his car is ready.
請告訴李先生他的車準備好了。
Ms. Chen will be on {vacation} until next Monday.
We are meeting a new {client} from Japan this afternoon.
我們今天下午要和一位來自日本的新客戶開會。
The manual is also available as an {e-book}.
這本手冊也有電子書版本。
A shuttle bus will take you to the {airport}.
The manager sent a {memo} about the new dress code.
經理發了一份關於新服裝規定的備忘錄。
I'd like to make a {reservation} for four at seven o'clock.
我想訂七點四位的位子。
Moving the meeting to Friday seems like the most {logical} choice.
把會議改到週五似乎是最合理的選擇。
Please send the signed form by {fax} or e-mail.
請用傳真或電子郵件寄回簽好的表格。
The store opens at nine {o'clock} on weekdays.

m: 真誠地、衷心地（信末用語：Sincerely 敬上）
ex: We {sincerely} apologize for the delay in your order.
對於您的訂單延誤，我們深感抱歉。
Let's have lunch together {sometime} next week.
我們下週找個時間一起吃午餐吧。
Ask your {supervisor} before you change the schedule.
改班表之前要先問你的主管。
You can get a full {refund} within thirty days.
三十天內可以全額退款。
The {goods} will be shipped from our warehouse tomorrow.
貨物明天會從我們的倉庫出貨。
All new employees must attend a safety {workshop}.
所有新員工都必須參加安全研習。
The company is moving to a {downtown} office.
公司要搬到市中心的辦公室。
The {deadline} for the report is Friday at noon.
報告的截止期限是週五中午。
The {invoice} must be paid within thirty days.
這張發票必須在三十天內付款。
Please take a {brochure} about our travel packages.
請拿一份我們旅遊套裝行程的簡介。
Our {accountant} is preparing this year's tax forms.
我們的會計師正在準備今年的報稅表。
The {clerk} at the front desk will give you a key.
櫃臺的職員會給你鑰匙。
I'll wait for you in the hotel {lobby}.
The company will {publish} its annual report in March.
公司將在三月發表年度報告。
Please send your {résumé} to the human resources department.
請把履歷寄到人資部門。
I have {enclosed} a copy of the contract.
隨信附上一份合約影本。
Each {applicant} will be interviewed by two managers.
每位應徵者都會由兩位經理面試。
She gave a talk at a marketing {seminar}.
她在一場行銷研討會上演講。
A {technician} is coming to fix the printer.
技術人員要來修印表機。
Clean the screen with a soft {cloth}.
The bus {fare} has gone up by ten percent.
公車票價漲了百分之十。
Keep your {receipt} in case you need to return the item.
保留收據，以防你需要退貨。
Business {travelers} can use the airport lounge.
商務旅客可以使用機場貴賓室。

m: 打電話的人、來電者、訪客
ex: The {caller} left a message for you.
It's faster to take the {subway} during rush hour.
尖峰時段搭地鐵比較快。
Please do not leave your {luggage} unattended.
請勿讓您的行李無人看管。
這批貨應該週四前會到。
What can be {inferred} from the e-mail?
從這封電子郵件可以推論出什麼？
The {waiter} recommended the fish of the day.
服務生推薦了今日鮮魚。
The laptop comes with a two-year {warranty}.
Lunch is served in the {cafeteria} on the second floor.
午餐在二樓的員工餐廳供應。
The {chef} is preparing a special menu for the event.
主廚正在為這場活動準備特別菜單。
The {elevator} is out of order, so please use the stairs.

m: 接待、歡迎會、接待處、收訊
ex: There will be a {reception} after the awards ceremony.
頒獎典禮後會有一場歡迎酒會。
Make sure the form is filled out {correctly}.
The {lease} on our office expires next year.
我們辦公室的租約明年到期。
More employees are riding a {bicycle} to work.
越來越多員工騎腳踏車上班。
Please {notify} us if you change your address.
如果你更改地址，請通知我們。
Members are invited to a {preview} of the new collection.
會員受邀參加新系列的預覽會。

m: 服務員、侍者、隨從（flight attendant：空服員）
ex: A parking {attendant} will show you where to park.
停車場服務員會告訴你停在哪裡。
Read the {manual} before using the machine.
使用機器前先閱讀說明書。
The sales figures give us a {clue} about what customers want.
銷售數字讓我們得到顧客需求的線索。
Visitors can park in the {garage} under the building.
訪客可以停在大樓下的停車場。
You must {obtain} a permit before starting construction.
開工前必須先取得許可證。
The meeting room has a large {oval} table.
會議室有一張大型橢圓桌。
We check our {inventory} at the end of every month.
我們每個月底清點庫存。
The company picnic will be held at an {outdoor} park.
公司野餐會在戶外公園舉行。
He packed his {suitcase} for the business trip.
他為出差打包了行李箱。
Tokyo is a popular {destination} for business travelers.
東京是商務旅客常去的目的地。
Please write your name and {occupation} on the form.
請在表格上填寫姓名和職業。
The meeting has been {postponed} until next week.
The new data seems to {contradict} last year's report.
新數據似乎和去年的報告互相矛盾。
Don't forget your {umbrella}; it's going to rain.
What {inference} can be made about the speaker?
關於說話者可以做出什麼推論？
Please turn off your {cellphone} during the presentation.
This {compact} printer fits on any desk.
這臺小巧的印表機放在哪張桌子都放得下。
All {merchandise} is 20 percent off this weekend.
這個週末所有商品打八折。
The {receptionist} will sign you in at the front desk.
櫃臺接待員會幫你登記。
I have an appointment with the {dentist} at three.
Visitors must show photo {identification} at the entrance.
訪客必須在入口出示附照片的身分證件。
Use this {coupon} to get a free coffee.
用這張優惠券可以換一杯免費咖啡。
火車將從第三月臺發車。
Could we {reschedule} the interview for Thursday?
我們可以把面試改到週四嗎？
Lowering prices is a common sales {tactic}.
降價是常見的銷售策略。
We plan to {upgrade} all our computers this year.
我們打算今年把所有電腦升級。
A short reception will {precede} the dinner.
晚宴前會先有一場簡短的酒會。
We will send you a {replacement} for the broken item.
我們會寄給你一個替換損壞品的新品。
Guests can {dine} on the hotel's rooftop terrace.
房客可以在飯店的屋頂露臺用餐。
Make sure your {passport} is valid for six months.
確認你的護照還有六個月效期。
She went to lunch with her {coworkers}.

m: 即將來臨的、即將出現的
ex: Please review the agenda for the {upcoming} meeting.
請先看過即將召開的會議議程。
The files are kept in a locked {cabinet}.
檔案收在上鎖的櫃子裡。
The store sells kitchen {appliances} at low prices.
這家店以低價販售廚房電器。
Each chart comes with a short {explanatory} note.
每張圖表都附有簡短的說明。
The {instructor} will show you how to use the software.
講師會示範如何使用這個軟體。
我的鍵盤今天早上壞了。
The new product got a lot of attention from the {media}.
新產品受到媒體大量關注。
The {supermarket} is open 24 hours a day.
這家超市二十四小時營業。
This ticket is {valid} for one month.

m: 入場、入學許可、入場費、承認
ex: {Admission} to the museum is free on Sundays.
Employees may bring their own {laptops} to the training.
員工可以帶自己的筆電參加培訓。
Please {underline} the key points in the contract.
請在合約重點下面畫線。
An {electrical} problem caused the power outage.
停電是電路問題造成的。
Her first {assignment} was to plan the sales event.
她的第一項任務是規劃促銷活動。
The emergency {exit} is at the end of the hallway.
Each {attendee} will receive a name badge.
每位與會者都會拿到一張名牌。
They won a free {cruise} to the Caribbean.
他們抽中免費的加勒比海郵輪之旅。
We're having a small party for Tom's {birthday}.
我們要為湯姆的生日辦個小派對。
Let's discuss the plan over coffee at the {café}.
我們去咖啡館邊喝咖啡邊討論計畫吧。
這項測驗評量閱讀理解能力。
The new store is located in the shopping {mall}.
Take this {medication} twice a day after meals.
這個藥一天兩次，飯後吃。
You need to {renew} your membership every year.
你的會員資格每年都要續約。
The building has twenty {tenants}, mostly small businesses.
這棟大樓有二十個租戶，大多是小公司。
Coffee and {sandwiches} will be served at the meeting.
會議中會提供咖啡和三明治。
Please check in two hours before {departure}.
請在起飛前兩小時辦理報到。
每間房都有一臺迷你冰箱。
The hotel has a {fitness} center on the top floor.
We apologize for any {inconvenience} this may cause.
若因此造成任何不便，敬請見諒。
The company holds a {banquet} at the end of each year.
公司每年年底都會舉辦尾牙宴。
There is a {closet} for coats near the entrance.
入口附近有一個掛外套的衣櫃。
The sales numbers this month look almost {unreal}.
這個月的業績數字好到幾乎不真實。

m: （選擇題的）誘答選項、干擾選項
ex: One {distractor} uses a word from the passage to trick you.
有個誘答選項會用文章裡的字來騙你。
Save the file in the shared {folder}.
把檔案存在共用資料夾裡。
Please bring a {photocopy} of your passport.
The hotel plans to {renovate} all its rooms.
飯店打算整修所有房間。

m: 晴朗的、陽光充足的、開朗的
ex: It will be {sunny} for the company picnic.
公司野餐那天會是晴天。
I'll mark the meeting on my {calendar}.
我會把會議記在行事曆上。
The firm made a large {donation} to the local school.
這家公司捐了一大筆錢給當地學校。
我們歡迎顧客提供意見。
Light {snacks} will be provided during the break.
休息時間會提供輕食點心。
The {warehouse} is located near the port.
The {copier} on the third floor is jammed again.
三樓的影印機又卡紙了。
We are looking for a new internet service {provider}.
我們在找新的網路服務供應商。
Hot and cold {beverages} are available in the lounge.
The meeting ran long, so everyone was {hungry}.
會議開太久，大家都餓了。
Please check the name of the {recipient} before sending.
寄出前請確認收件人姓名。
Would you prefer a window or an {aisle} seat?
您想要靠窗還是靠走道的座位？
An engineer will {inspect} the building next week.
下週會有工程師來檢查大樓。
The {mechanic} said the car needs new brakes.
技師說這輛車需要換煞車。
The {merger} will create the largest bank in the country.
這次合併將成立國內最大的銀行。
有幾位員工下班後會去踢足球。
Bring a {sweater}; the office can get cold.
帶件毛衣，辦公室有時候會很冷。
我們只使用新鮮的在地食材。
Could you {rewrite} the introduction to make it shorter?
你可以把開頭改寫得短一點嗎？
Your travel {itinerary} has been sent to your e-mail.
您的行程表已寄到您的信箱。
We want to create a safe and friendly {workplace}.
我們希望打造安全又友善的工作環境。
The {architect} showed us the design for the new office.
建築師給我們看新辦公室的設計。
For your {convenience}, we offer free parking.
為了您的方便，我們提供免費停車。

m: 有資格的、合格的、適合的
ex: Full-time staff are {eligible} for health insurance.
全職員工有資格享有健康保險。
The hotel has an {indoor} swimming pool.
You may check two pieces of {baggage} for free.
您可以免費托運兩件行李。
Store the food in an airtight {container}.
把食物放在密封容器裡保存。
The spare keys are in the top {drawer}.
備用鑰匙在最上面的抽屜裡。
The new product is being tested in our {lab}.
新產品正在我們的實驗室測試。
提交截止日是五月一日。
The schedule is posted on the {bulletin} board.
You will receive a {certificate} after completing the course.
完成課程後你會拿到一張證書。
The company pays for employees' {gym} memberships.
公司幫員工付健身房的會費。
Traffic on the {highway} was heavy this morning.
今天早上公路上車很多。
Most {respondents} were happy with our service.
大部分受訪者對我們的服務感到滿意。
We had to work {overtime} to finish the project.
我們得加班才能完成這個專案。
The {battery} lasts up to ten hours.
這顆電池最多可以用十小時。
The company {donated} computers to the library.
公司捐了電腦給圖書館。

m: 傑出的、顯著的、未解決的
ex: She received an award for {outstanding} performance.

m: 略讀、瀏覽、撇去（浮沫）、掠過
ex: {Skim} the article first, and then read it carefully.
先略讀文章，再仔細讀一遍。
He left his {briefcase} in the taxi.
他把公事包忘在計程車上。
Coffee and {dessert} will be served after dinner.
晚餐後會供應咖啡和甜點。
The new policy had a big {impact} on sales.
新政策對銷售有很大的影響。
The company is known for its {innovative} products.
這家公司以創新產品聞名。
I'm calling to {inquire} about the job opening.
我打電話來詢問職缺的事。
The {venue} for the conference has not been decided.
研討會的場地還沒決定。
The train is crowded with {commuters} in the morning.
早上火車上擠滿了通勤族。
The company changed its {logo} last year.
訂閱我們的每月電子報。
The printer needs a new ink {cartridge}.
印表機需要換新的墨水匣。
It will be {cloudy} with a chance of rain.
A {photographer} will take pictures at the event.
假日購物人潮擠滿了商店。
Check the price {tag} before you buy.
The {announcer} said the flight would be delayed.
We discussed every {aspect} of the plan.
我們討論了計畫的每個面向。
The company has an {audit} every year.
公司每年都會接受審計。
The {contractor} promised to finish the work by June.
承包商承諾六月前完工。
You can {download} the form from our website.
你可以從我們的網站下載表格。
每三個月更換一次密碼。
The concert will take place at the city {stadium}.
演唱會將在市立體育場舉行。
國際航班從第二航廈出發。
The office is open on {weekdays} only.
全體員工都領到年終獎金。
Please return your shopping {cart} after use.
The food at the banquet was {delicious}.
Please sign the form in black {ink}.
She {supervises} a team of ten people.
她管理一個十人的團隊。
女服務生拿菜單給我們。
The {cleaners} come in after the office closes.
清潔人員在辦公室下班後進來打掃。
The {developer} plans to build apartments on the land.
建商打算在這塊地上蓋公寓。
這家公司的總部設在臺北。
A free {shuttle} runs between the hotel and the airport.
飯店和機場之間有免費接駁車。
文具請透過辦公室經理訂購。
You can {subscribe} to the magazine online.
你可以在網路上訂閱這本雜誌。
The new policy will help customers and staff {alike}.
新政策對顧客和員工都有幫助。
The ice cream comes in ten {flavors}.
這款冰淇淋有十種口味。
The annual company {picnic} is next Saturday.
公司年度野餐在下週六。
The chef shared his {recipe} for the soup.
主廚分享了這道湯的食譜。
{Refreshments} will be served in the lobby.
She handles {administrative} tasks for the department.
她負責部門的行政工作。
只有經理可以核准大筆付款。
This software is {commonly} used in hospitals.
這款軟體在醫院很常用。
這家公司負責亞洲各地的配送。
Please wait on the {sofa} in the lobby.
請在大廳的沙發上稍候。

m: 容納、提供住宿、適應、通融
ex: The hall can {accommodate} up to 300 guests.
這個大廳最多可容納三百位賓客。

m: 負擔得起的、價格合理的
ex: We offer high-quality products at {affordable} prices.
我們以實惠的價格提供高品質產品。
The loud music {annoyed} the other guests.
吵雜的音樂讓其他客人很煩。
Many workers {commute} by train every day.
很多上班族每天搭火車通勤。
Ms. Park will {coordinate} the training sessions.
朴小姐會負責統籌培訓課程。
Please complete the {paperwork} before your first day.
請在第一天上班前填好文件。
He {quit} his job to start his own business.
Only the manager has the {authority} to approve refunds.
只有經理有權核准退款。
Half the team was out with the {flu}.
團隊有一半的人得流感請假。
The {captain} announced that we would land soon.
機長廣播說我們快要降落了。
{Installation} of the new software takes about an hour.
安裝新軟體大約要一個小時。
A personal {trainer} is available at the gym.
Please check room {availability} for next weekend.
請查一下下週末還有沒有空房。
At this price, the laptop is a real {bargain}.
這個價錢買這臺筆電真的很划算。
The team went on a {hike} in the mountains.
The event will move indoors if it's {rainy}.
如果下雨，活動會移到室內。
The company will {relocate} to a larger office.
公司將搬到更大的辦公室。
每位受訓者都配有一位導師。
Every {transaction} is recorded in the system.
每一筆交易都會記錄在系統裡。
The customer was {unhappy} with the late delivery.
顧客對延遲到貨很不滿。
請驗證您的電子郵件地址。
He works for a large {automobile} company.
他在一家大型汽車公司工作。
The documents will be sent by {courier}.

m: 不完全的、未完成的、不完善的
ex: 資料不全的申請將不予受理。
請填寫這份簡短的問卷。
The company sponsors a local {baseball} team.
公司贊助一支當地棒球隊。
The ship is unloading at the {dock}.
There is a reading {lamp} next to the bed.
最近銷售量一直在增加。
The factory bought new {machinery} this year.
工廠今年購買了新機器。
The {presenter} answered questions after the talk.
報告人在演講後回答問題。
The manager {seldom} leaves the office before seven.
經理很少在七點前離開辦公室。
The contract needs your {signature} on the last page.
合約最後一頁需要你的簽名。
這家公司在全球有超過五千名員工。

m: 運送者、航空公司、帶原者
ex: Our package was delivered by a different {carrier}.
我們的包裹是由另一家貨運公司送達的。
This area has been {designated} for visitor parking.
這個區域已被指定為訪客停車區。

m: 獨家的、專屬的、排外的、高級的
ex: Members get {exclusive} discounts on new products.
會員可享新品獨家折扣。
She stopped at the {grocery} store on her way home.
她回家途中順路去了雜貨店。
Do your {homework} before you meet the client.
和客戶見面前要先做好功課。
The {memorandum} explains the new travel policy.
這份備忘錄說明了新的差旅規定。
The {photocopier} is out of paper again.
The CEO is staying in the hotel's largest {suite}.
執行長住在飯店最大的套房。
The auditors did a {thorough} review of our records.
稽核人員徹底檢查了我們的紀錄。
The {bookstore} is holding a book signing on Saturday.
